A total of 18 teams will compete in the league. The season began on 9 February 2018 and is scheduled to conclude on 7 October 2018.{{cite web |url=http://www.thaileague.co.th/official/?r=News%2FNewsRead&id=3614 |title=T1 and T2 schedules from Thai League official website |work=thaileague.co.th |publisher=Premier League Thailand |date=18 December 2017 |access-date=18 December 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181020053300/https://www.thaileague.co.th/official/?r=News%2FNewsRead&id=3614 |archive-date=20 October 2018 |url-status=dead }} [[Buriram United F.C.|Buriram United]] are the defending champions, while [[Chainat Hornbill F.C.|Chainat Hornbill]], [[Air Force Central F.C.|Air Force Central]] and [[Prachuap F.C.|Prachuap]] have entered as the promoted teams from the [[2017 Thai League 2]].
